senses.gloss:
शीघ्र शीघ्र, अस्, आ, अम् (etymology doubt-
ful), quick, speedy; (अस्), m. (in astronomy) con-
junction; (according to others) parallax; N. of a
king; (आ), f., N. of a river; a particular plant, =
दन्ती; (अम्), ind. quickly, rapidly, swiftly; [cf. Gr.
κιχάνω; Angl. Sax. higian.]
—शिघ्र-कर्मन्,
अ, n. (in astronomy) the calculation of the conjunc-
tion (of a planet).
—शिघ्र-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, acting
speedily or expeditiously.
—शिघ्र-कृत्य, अस्, आ,
अम्, to be done quickly, what must be done quickly.
—शिघ्र-केन्द्र, अम्, n. (in astronomy) the dis-
tance from the conjunction (of a planet), commuta-
tion.
—शिघ्र-कोपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, quickly angry, irri-
table.
—शीघ्र-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going quickly; (अस्),
m., N. of a king.
—शिघ्र-गन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, or
शीघ्र-गमन, अस्, आ, अम्, going quickly.
—शी-
घ्र-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going or moving quickly,
swift, expeditious.
—शीघ्र-चेतन, अस्, आ, अम्,
having quick intellect, very sagacious; (अस्), m. a
dog.
—शीघ्र-जन्मन्, आ, m. ‘having quick birth,’
the plant Cæsalpinia Bonducella; another plant (=
करञ्ज).
—शीघ्र-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more quick,
very swift; (अम्), ind. as swiftly as possible.
—शी-
घ्र-ता, f. or शीघ्र-त्व, अम्, n. quickness, speed,
rapidity.
—शीघ्र-परिधि, इस्, m. (in astronomy)
the epicycle of a conjunction.
—शीघ्र-पुष्प, अस्,
m. ‘quick-flowering,’ a kind of plant (= अगस्त्य).
—शीघ्र-फल, अम्, n. (in astronomy) the equation
of a conjunction.
—शीघ्र-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, quick-
witted, having quick apprehension, acute, sharp.
—शी-
घ्र-यान, अम्, n. rapid motion.
—शिघ्र-लङ्-
घन, अस्, आ, अम्, springing or jumping quickly,
moving rapidly.
—शिघ्र-वेग, अस्, आ, अम्, having
a rapid course, impetuous.
—शीघ्र-वेधिन्, ई, m.
‘quickly piercing (the mark),’ a good archer.
—शी-
घ्र-श्रोतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having a rapid current (said
of a river)
—शीघ्रोच्च (˚र-उच्˚), अस्, m. ‘the apex of
the swiftest motion,’ a conjunction (in astronomy).

शिघ्राय, Nom. A. शीघ्रायते, -यितुम्, to be-
come quick or rapid; to hasten.

शीघ्रायमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming quick,
going rapidly, hastening.

शीघ्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, speedy, one who is quick or
expeditious.

शीघ्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, quick, fleet; (अस्), m. an
epithet of Śiva; of Viṣṇu; the fighting of cats.
शीघ्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, quick, speedy, rapid, swift.
शीघ्र्य, अम्, n. quickness, speed, rapidity.
